entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clarence Napier Bruce, 3rd Baron Aberdare, styled The Honourable Clarence Bruce from 1895 to 1929, was a British military officer, cricketer, tennis player, and golfer who worked as a sports administrator. He was killed in an automobile accident in 1957 after attending an International Olympic Committee meeting in the Balkans.
